$comment: Startup kits for One-Sentence Startup (docs/ai-layer.md, 3.2; [ai-02]): the coworking sign-up form's 'What are you building?' picks one by keyword (src/content/kits.ts matchKit), after the crisis check. A kit is the fallback for every refusal except self_harm, which shows the crisis lines and never a kit. The typed sentence is never displayed; only the kit is. nameParts are ids into name-parts.json, composed by src/content/composer.ts ({name} in the copy, at most 16 characters). Slides: problem, solution, then market, traction and ask from shared templates. Kits marked fallback are about startup culture, not any topic, and are the pool a refused or unmatched sentence draws from by keyed hash.
